## What we do

Quantex is an AI studio in Beirut. We build Gemini-powered assistants on WhatsApp and the web with a human handoff, business process automation, and custom software and cloud architecture. Our Next.js sites on Vercel are built search-ready from the first commit—clean structure, fast Core Web Vitals, and measurement in Google Search Console—with technical SEO as a standalone service.
